P3.finding: wait_closed creates a websocket wait task but does not cancel/reap it if its caller is cancelled. Repeated cancellation retains one task per call until connection close.

actual_fake_connection_observation.observation: Spawned wait tasks outlive cancelled public wait calls until the connection closes.

P3.suggestion: Use finally to cancel and await the local closed task, preserving the shared refusal future.

limits: Python3.9 preflight was unsupported and had no pytest; used isolated supported3.12 environment with declared dependencies.
Local TLS FakeLamp only; no real lamp-control/server or device qualification.
The existing refused-handler registration P3 remains separately tracked by the author.
No SDK source edits or project dependency/lockfile changes.
